headline: Taiwan's Newborns Plunge! 32 Consecutive Months of Population Decline; 股添樂 Warns: These Industries Are in Trouble | Finance | SETN.COM
summary: Taiwan recorded 7,492 newborns in August and over 11,000 fewer people in the first eight months combined. The population has declined for 32 consecutive months.
why: Falling birth rates shape long-term labor supply, housing demand and consumer spending, which matter for sector and macro forecasts.
